# Move.it

> A gamified wellness app that nudges you to take short physical breaks during long focus sessions like work or studying.

## What it does

Move.it combines Pomodoro timers with physical micro-challenges. Every 25 minutes, a random body or eye exercise appears. Complete it to earn XP and level up. Skip it and lose the round. Progress persists in localStorage — no account or backend needed.

## Key features

- 25-minute Pomodoro countdown timer
- Random physical challenges (stretches, neck rolls, eye exercises)
- XP and leveling system
- Avatar generated from your name via DiceBear, or upload your own photo
- All state saved to localStorage (no login required)

## Stack

- Next.js (React framework)
- DiceBear (avatar generation)
- localStorage (client-side persistence)
- Hosted on Vercel

## URL

https://moveit-pomodoro.vercel.app/
